name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1806: At 640x400 with the claim bar up, the bar takes the top 139px and the dock the bottom 178px of a 400px viewport. The tab strip lands inside the dock and elementFromPoint over the Tools tab returns the dock, so a first-time visitor on a short window cannot change tabs at all. The dock now stands aside below 620px tall, reusing the collapse it already has, and without persisting that to his saved preference.
